- cleanup alt* keys from info plist including appgroups and replace appgroup lookup with machoparser to read from machO header quickly for active appgroup entilements as ground truth
- cleanup legacy stuff
- added pre db startup maintenence + cleanup by moving to sidestore convention
- added auto migration of cached app to new format
- missed adding info.plist changes in last commit for bg location services
- added bg processing modes thru audio and location with choices
- updated minimuxer for on-device JIT support
- fixes for enableJIT notifications - prefer notif and fallback to toast if not avail
- promote cell refresh into user customizations now that it is stable
- fix: added safeXXX minimuxer methods so that pre-req missing are handled properly
- fix: added definitive waits for minimuxer to be ready upon cell shortcuts refresh

- updated to latest
- added diag logging
- updated submodules to latest
- fix: since wg is server connection is on-demand and keep-alive is 25 sec, we need to self probe wg client to trigger (ready!!) binding to our emp server from the client before confirming start() is complete

- cleanup: use isExtension based detection

- cleanup: remove the backdoor access thru class func in installed app and enforce strict access thru the fields on instance instead of open access thru static/class func

- fix: let the finger printing decide to cache or not ie remove forced caching in debug Mode
- fix: make reconcile at boot to use the new fingerprinted caching to detect if we really need to cache
- feature: make cachedApp idempotent by computing merkele tree hash as signature of all collective files so that if same app is used we don't take up more space for caching - useful for cloing or multi-apps like itorrent etc
- skip resign and how-tos during onboarding sign-in
- fix(ui): use dynamic device services naming in onboarding
- cleanup: remove direct bundle access to use ALTApplication ie AppBudnle and infoPlistParser
- fix(CI): Only run first-interaction for first time contributors
- feat(ui): Add onboarding flow for first launch
- feat(ui): Rewrite splash screen in SwiftUI
- fix: remove implicit fallback behavirs (wip)
- remove compat stuff since final structure is decently stable
- prefer resigned id for caching
- removed premature cleanup and prefer resigned bundleid since we just did install
- merge multiple caching into one and do after install
- added capability in appInfo to view resigned metadata vs cached bundle metadata based on availability.
- feature: added .mobileprovision caching so that in appinfo view we can show real last resigned profile data.
- fix: changes drafts should be held in own container so that edits of app, appex won't be interfering in each other
- remove identitiy entitlements from being customized coz they will get it right during resign anyways
- remove redundant fallbacks to be deterministic
- cleanup duplicate logic and streamline by making installedApp authoritative holder of truth
- remove custom parsing with standard infoplist parser
- added capability to patch info.plist of all bundles including main app and extensions
- cleanup
- refine the cahe customizations op by handling per appid for both info.plist and entitlements
- rename to CacheUserCustomizationsOperation
- handle extensions entitlrments processing properly
- make the ellipsis in views if were cut short, expandable on tap
- reorder things in user customizations
- fixed missing imports and compile issues + remove unicode chars to denote "..."
- fix: update to any sendable instead of any coz our plist data is usually sendable
- moved up InfoPlistParser into SideSign
- added entitlements customization feature
- prep for entitlements and move things a bit around
- [skip ci] AGENTS.md: Add agent guidelines (#1540)
- fix: resign wasn't preserving customized info.plist bundleid
- ensure spinner is always terminated upon success/failure
- added sheet vs dialog preference for info.plist customization + refine account verification row
- extract common view out coz we can now have both views with user choice on which to use
- fix: use authenticated team during installs
- refine the pipeline operations and remove unnecessary stuffs from appmanager
- move out codesign validation to post sign-in flow completion only
- clean the mess up in sign-in flow - removed redundant fetches and saves for acct and team, make provision into single invocation instead of a loop now.
- remove the redundant proxy method incorrectly named as authenticate where it was just doing a fetchAccts with already authenticated xcodeToken
- ditch silent sign-in coz we dont need it anymore, we use proper explicit sign in since sign-in flow doesnt require auto sign in anymore
- refine the sign-in flow vs provisioning flow further
- use force fetch of UDID in boot, health check, connection config where live status is non negotiable or determines connectivity statuses
- fix: store udid in keychain coz it never changes
- cleanup
- cleanup errors
- sign-in: split signin flow into signin + cert provision + device registration for maintenance and better clarity

apps.localizedDescription:
MiniStore is SideStore with the interface sanded down.

Everything SideStore does, MiniStore does — it sideloads apps onto your device with just an Apple ID, resigns them with your personal development certificate, and refreshes them in the background so the 7-day development period never expires.

What it adds:

• OLED dark mode — true black throughout, applied live without a relaunch.
• Accent colour theming — presets or a custom colour, across every tab and the home screen widget.
• Reorganised settings — a list of categories instead of one long scroll.
• Tab customization — hide the tabs you don't use and choose which one opens on launch.
• What's New — release notes read straight from GitHub.
• A preloaded catalogue so there is something to browse immediately.

MiniStore is a thin layer on top of SideStore, kept deliberately small so upstream releases can be merged in as they land.
